verified_claims.finding: Opened the July 12, 2017 operator-authored account: the failed autotransformer replacement entered service June 9 after nine installation days using normal daylight shifts. This is one installation, not total customer interruption or an independent outage audit.

verified_claims.after: 36 months | Commonly quoted LPT procurement lead time in DOE's July 2024 review; historical, not current.

verified_claims.after: 60 months | Maximum LPT procurement quotations in DOE's July 2024 review; historical, not current.
verified_claims.finding: Checked printed page 2 of the opened July 2024 report: maximum acquisition lead times reached as much as 60 months. This supports the dated quotation maximum, not a universal maximum or current market measurement.

This is reported subscription spending, not transformer pricing or independently audited savings. Only the six listed additions were source-reviewed; unchanged facts retain original approval only.
